role: The phase profiler (make -C csrc phase-profile, test_snapshots --phase-profile): at every PHASE_RUN mark and PHASE_SUB sub-mark it reads the TSC (clock_gettime off x86) and, with tests/allocount.c preloaded, the process's allocation count; per row it keeps each (phase, world) column and sub-mark in a mapping reserved at the start; the summary gives per column runs, total, share of session_tick, per-row mean, p50, p99 and max with its row, allocations per row, the five worst rows with the phases and sub-marks they spent their time in, and the environment's state sizes (chunks, bands, packed region blobs per world, the arena pools, peak RSS).
gpu: harness only: on when a test turns it on; its rows live in one mmap made before the first row, so it allocates nothing inside a row
notes: First used for out/plan/gpu-audit-2026-09-26.md (lane/gpuprof2). The sub-marks are inclusive and count the outermost entry only, so LOAD contains GEN, POP and the light work a load triggers.
